$comment: Single source of truth for job infrastructure. Read by Terraform (Cloud Scheduler, Pub/Sub) and TypeScript (schedule metadata). Run the pre-commit hook or `pnpm -C apps/jobs validate:manifest` to check for drift.

community.dispatch-rsvp-confirmations.description: Drain the RSVP-confirmation outbox and send each newly-RSVP'd attendee an in-app + email confirmation with event details and links to the event page and /my-rsvps, with retry and dead-lettering.

community.purge-dispatched-rsvp-notices.description: Delete dispatched RSVP-confirmation notices past the retention window so (eventId, humanId) linkage rows don't accumulate at rest indefinitely. Never deletes undispatched/in-flight notices.

community.refresh-recurring-dates.description: Rolling re-expansion of recurring community listings: tops up each listing's EventDate window and re-pins Event.startsAt to the next upcoming date so recurring listings stay 'upcoming' in discovery + geo×category SEO.

booking-requests.auto-expire.description: Daily expiry of open (PENDING/VIEWED) performer booking requests past their TTL.

events.expire-applications.description: Nightly expiry of PENDING event-application submissions whose form closed more than the grace window (7 days) ago — flips them to EXPIRED in one batch, no emails.

post-event-prompts.enqueue.description: Daily sweep that enqueues post-event prompts into the shared PostEventPrompt outbox: PERFORMER prompts for completed platform-booked gigs, then ATTENDEE prompts for scanned ticket holders of ended events (performer-prompted humans excluded). Idempotent via the (eventId, humanId, audience) unique index.

post-event-prompts.dispatch.description: Drain the post-event prompt outbox: one-time in-app + email post-gig review prompt per performer, deep-linking to /review-a-place, with retry and dead-lettering. ATTENDEE prompts stay pending (dispatch-gated) until the attendee review form ships.

attendee-reviews.recompute-aggregates.description: Weekly rebuild of the anonymized attendee-review aggregate snapshots (threshold-gated, bucketed) served on event, venue, organizer and series surfaces. Weekly on purpose: the delay defeats temporal correlation.

attendee-review-digests.send.description: Weekly attendee review-prompt email digest: one email per human listing their un-reviewed, still-in-window attended shows, with a one-click unsubscribe (List-Unsubscribe header) and 3-strike soft auto-suppression. In-app prompts are unaffected. Idempotent per (human, week) via NotificationDigestLog.

analytics.event-daily-stats.description: Nightly aggregation of per-event sell-through, revenue, and ticket stats.

analytics.resale-price-snapshots.description: Nightly refresh of resale price suggestions based on recent market data.

events.dispatch-change-notifications.description: Drain the event-change notification outbox (cancel / reschedule / venue-change) and fan each notice out to its watchers (savers + RSVPers) and refunded buyers over in-app + email, with retry and dead-lettering.

events.address-reveal-notify.description: Notify active ticket holders of OBSCURED events whose addressRevealAt just crossed that the exact address is now live (in-app forced on + email/push per preference). Idempotent via the per-event addressRevealNotifiedAt cursor.

events.purge-dispatched-change-notices.description: Delete dispatched event-change notices past the retention window so the buyer humanIds and refund amounts persisted in CANCELLED payloads don't live at rest indefinitely. Never deletes undispatched/in-flight notices.

places.cleanup-stale-verification-docs.description: Daily cleanup of orphaned verification documents from R2 storage.

places.recalculate-place-stats.description: Recalculates aggregate stats (payout, scores, draw, flags, genre cloud) for places with stale review data.

places.recompute-public-snapshots.description: Weekly rebuild of the anonymized public review snapshots (threshold-gated, bucketed aggregates) served on place pages. Weekly on purpose: the delay defeats temporal correlation.

humans.compute-human-stats.description: Recomputes materialized performer stats from attributions, events, and follows.

orgs.compute-org-stats.description: Recomputes materialized organization stats from events, orders, attributions, and follows.

search.full-reindex.description: Rebuild the selected search backend index (events, humans, places, organizations) from scratch.

search.reindex-scheduled-price-flips.description: Re-index events whose ticket-type scheduled price change (TicketType.scheduledPriceAt) crossed inside the scan window, so the search index's materialized minPaidPriceCents stops advertising the pre-flip price. Price stays read-time truth everywhere that takes money; this only refreshes a derived cache. Idempotent (the document is rewritten from source rows), and the 6h lookback absorbs cron drift. If it never runs, browse cards go stale until the nightly full reindex — never a mispriced sale.

stripe-connect.reconcile-capabilities.description: Pull-based backstop for connected-account capability state. `account.updated` is the only push writer of Payee.chargesEnabled/payoutsEnabled, so a webhook that is never delivered or fails our shape guard leaves an org silently unable to publish a paid event. Re-reads the stalest accounts through the same derivation the webhook uses, and reports how many had drifted. Runs before the payout batch so a healed payee is payable the same night.

settlements.verify-ledger._comment: Terraform-visible: this entry mints a Cloud Scheduler job on the next apply. Deliberately 4h AFTER settlements.run-batch (midnight CT) so the sweep audits the night's PAYOUT/RESERVE writes at rest instead of racing them; the HTTP endpoint works (manual trigger from the platform jobs page) as soon as the handler deploys, before any apply.
settlements.verify-ledger.description: Read-only ledger reconciliation sweep (ledger-authoritative-settlement spec §9): recomputes PayeeLedgerBalance rollups from entries, checks per-(order,payee) refund conservation, and flags finalized orders missing SETTLEMENT_CREDITs. Reports via Sentry + Discord; never repairs.

sitemaps.generate.description: Generate sitemap XML files for SEO.

tickets.expire-resale-claims.description: Transition all open resale claims past their deadline to expired status.

tickets.expire-resale-listings.description: Expire ACTIVE resale listings past their expiry or event end.

tickets.release-expired-carts.description: Cancel stale PENDING orders and their Stripe PaymentIntents.

tickets.release-expired-holds.description: Release seat holds that have exceeded their TTL.

volunteers.reminders-24h.description: Email/SMS/in-app reminders to volunteers ~24h before their shift. Window is +23h45m to +24h15m, so the */15 tick catches every shift exactly once.

volunteers.reminders-1h.description: Email/SMS/in-app reminders to volunteers ~1h before their shift. Window is +55m to +65m, so the */5 tick catches every shift exactly once.

storage.sweep-orphaned-uploads.description: Clean up orphaned audio and image uploads — stalled transcodes, images no event still references, expired soft-deletes.

storage.drain-pending-deletions.description: Drain the object-storage deletion outbox: delete keys/prefixes enqueued in-transaction by event deletes, with exponential backoff and dead-lettering.

moderation.report-queue-health.description: Hourly health read over the image-moderation queue: images overdue for draining, images that failed to scan recently, images that exhausted the requeue cap, and flagged images awaiting human review too long. Raises a Discord alert ONLY when a count is non-zero, so an alert always means something.

moderation.requeue-degraded.description: Revive dead-lettered DEGRADED image-moderation rows (status FLAGGED + degraded, never reviewed, under the requeue cap) back to PENDING so the drain re-scores them once the provider recovers. Only rows the SCANNER failed on are eligible; a real content verdict is never revived. Hourly is deliberate: the drain's own retry window already covers outages up to ~3 days, so this is the slow backstop for anything longer.

moderation.drain-image-moderations.description: Drain the image-moderation outbox (PENDING ImageModerationRecord rows) through the moderation provider (Azure AI Content Safety, or the auto-approving stub when unconfigured), writing verdicts back onto each record. Retries transient provider failures with exponential backoff and dead-letters exhausted rows to FLAGGED+degraded so held images clear (or surface for review) quickly.

support.purge-resolved-threads.description: Delete resolved support threads (and their messages) past the retention window (SUPPORT_RETENTION_DAYS).

push.drain-receipts.description: Poll Expo push receipts for recently sent notifications and disable devices whose receipts report DeviceNotRegistered/InvalidCredentials (Expo only surfaces many dead installs in the receipt phase ~15min after the send ticket returns ok). Resolved and expired rows are deleted, so the PushReceipt outbox drains to empty.

idempotency.purge-expired.description: Delete idempotency records past their retention window (no-op on the Redis backend, which expires keys itself).

memberships.refresh-tax-jurisdictions.description: Re-confirm cached membership tax rates against the rate provider, archiving and replacing any that changed and repointing affected subscriptions. The ONLY trigger that can catch a jurisdiction changing its own rate — no member-side event ever signals one, so without this a member who never moves would be billed a stale rate indefinitely.

jobs.prune-run-history.description: Trim JobRun history to the retention cap across all jobs (no-op on the Redis backend, which trims on write).

admin.csv-export.description: Background CSV export for admin tables.

announcements.dispatch-notifications.description: Dispatches in-app / push notifications for an announcement.

search.index-event.description: Index a single event into the selected search backend.

search.index-human.description: Index a single human/profile into the selected search backend.

search.index-place.description: Index a single place/venue into the selected search backend.

search.index-organization.description: Index a single organization into the selected search backend.

settlements.execute-transfer._comment: HANDLERLESS as of the 2026-08-10 ledger cutover — the per-settlement transfer job is deleted; money moves only through settlements.run-batch. Entry retained deliberately: the topic + push subscription are Terraform-managed (infra/terraform/infracost-usage*.yml reference them), so removing it here is an INFRA change, not a code one. Follow-up: retire the topic and drop this entry together.
settlements.execute-transfer.description: DELETED job. Topic retained pending Terraform cleanup.

legacy_queue._comment: Pub/Sub topics from before the manifest existed. No code handlers — clean up or migrate as handlers are ported.

tickets.issue.description: Issue tickets for a completed order.

tickets.generate-qr.description: Generate and store QR code for a ticket.

tickets.send-reminder.description: Send event reminder notification to a user.

search.rebuild-event-index.description: Rebuild search index for an event.
